name: Sprayking Limited
about: Sprayking Limited manufactures and trades in brass products in India. It offers brass fittings, forging equipment, transformer parts, and other customized brass parts, as well as Brass billets and valves, sanitary and plumbing fittings, brass compression fittings, garden and agricultural sprayer fittings, electrical components, precision turned components, and industrial components. The company also provides turning components, brass compression fittings, brass sanitary fittings, brass pipe and plumbing fittings, extruded brass rods, ball valves and non-return valves, CNC fittings, and forging parts. In addition, it exports its products to the United States, Europe, Australia, Canada, South Africa, and the United Arab Emirates. The company was formerly known as Sprayking Agro Equipment Limited and changed its name to Sprayking Limited. Sprayking Limited was founded in 1977 and is headquartered in Jamnagar, India.
